title: ApprovalResolvedData
description: data of approval.resolved (PRD 9.5). A person answered a gate card (CR-07: only approve opens it). authz names that person or Team Lead, and gate_id, card_id and outbox_id link the side effect to this authorisation (HR-7). Only approve authorises, and only when authz.ref is the world's owner, the Approver approval.requested named, or a Team Lead it allows (OB-01): the outbox entry is written with exactly this authz, and its outgoing data.transfer carries it too; edit and hold write nothing. pin_verified is true when tilo-channels checked the person's PIN before accepting the answer (SEC-06); a T3 gate answered on WhatsApp opens only with it (OB-01), and a wrong or missing PIN emits no approval.resolved. Gates never time out to go, so a timeout emits no approval.resolved.
